review_comments.body:
** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Return an error when the next-page token repeats.** If two consecutive responses return `tok2`, this branch reports success without reaching the end of pagination. Both responses have already contributed model names, so the successful result can also contain duplicate entries. Callers that require `err == nil` will accept this result. Separate empty-token completion from repeated-token failure. Return an error for the repeated token, as the page-limit branch already does for exhausted pagination. Based on learnings: reject an unchanged pagination cursor rather than treating it as completion.
